description: ACT public holidays under the Holidays Act 1958 (ACT), as published by the ACT Government (Chief Minister, Treasury and Economic Development Directorate).

evidence.method: Firecrawl scrape of the official ACT Government public-holidays page on the checked date; page last updated 14 August 2026 and lists 2026 to 2029. The former cmtedd.act.gov.au/communication/holidays address now returns 404 and points to this page.

uncertain_windows.reason: Court Procedures Rules 2006 (ACT) r 6300(1)(b) closes the registry on days falling between 26 December and 1 January; a filing deadline landing here moves to the next working day under Legislation Act 2001 s 151A, but the closure is not a public holiday, so the script refuses rather than guesses.

caveats: Anzac Day 2026 falls on a Saturday and is observed on both Saturday 25 April and Monday 27 April; Anzac Day 2027 falls on a Sunday and is observed on both Sunday 25 April and Monday 26 April, as published.
Christmas Day 2027 falls on a Saturday: Saturday 25 and Monday 27 December are holidays, and Boxing Day is observed on Sunday 26 and Tuesday 28 December, as published.
The ACT bank holiday (first Monday in August) is not a public holiday and is not included.
